content_sections.text: Eligibility for each post depends on the required educational qualification and, for two posts, prior experience. Details for every post are given below. The notification does not specify a date for age reckoning or any age relaxation for reserved categories.

content_sections.heading: IGIMS Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: For Assistant Professor/ Senior Consultant and Senior Resident/ Consultant (Sl. No. 1 & 2): Selection will be made through Screening and Interview . For Clinical Psychologist/ Psychiatric Social Worker/ Psychiatric Nurse, Project Co-ordinator, and Data Entry Operator (Sl. No. 3, 4 & 5): Screening will be done, and if necessary, a written test may also be conducted in case a large number of applications are received. Applications will be scrutinized by a Screening Committee, and the final decision regarding appointment rests solely with the competent authority. The list of shortlisted candidates for interview/ test will be published on the IGIMS, official website. No separate communication will be sent regarding the date, time, and venue of the interview/ written test; candidates must keep checking www.igims.org. Mere fulfilment of the essential qualification does not guarantee selection.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for IGIMS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must submit the duly filled application form along with self-attested photocopies of the following documents: Duly filled prescribed application form Photocopy of Identification proof, viz. Aadhaar Card, Voter ID Card, Passport, or any other government identity proof Self-attested certificates, mark sheets, and degrees 10th Mark sheet Experience certificates MCI/ State Medical Council registration certificate (as applicable) No Objection Certificate (NOC), for candidates currently working in a government organization Any other relevant document Original certificates must be produced by shortlisted candidates at the time of the interview/ test, as no call letter will be issued separately.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IGIMS Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: The application process for this recruitment is entirely offline. Follow these steps to apply: Download the application form from the official website of IGIMS, -14 (www.igims.org). Fill the application form as per the prescribed proforma, ensuring no change is made to the serial number, order, or heading of any column. Attach self-attested photocopies of the certificates and all other required documents listed above. Additional annexures may be added as separate sheets if required. Superscribe the envelope with "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF -" (mentioning the specific post applied for). Send the completed application only through Speed Post/ Registered Post to: Director, Indira Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sheikhpura, -800014 (Bihar) . Ensure the application reaches the above address on or before 4 September 2026, by 5:00 PM . Applications will not be accepted through any other means.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IGIMS Patna Tele MANAS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of application is 4 September 2026, up to 5:00 PM, at the office of the Director, IGIMS, Patna.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IGIMS Patna Tele MANAS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 5 posts are advertised: Assistant Professor/ Senior Consultant, Senior Resident/ Consultant, Clinical Psychologist/ Psychiatric Social Worker/ Psychiatric Nurse, Project Co-ordinator, and Data Entry Operator, with one vacancy in each category.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for IGIMS Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application is offline only. Candidates must send the duly filled form via Speed Post or Registered Post; applications will not be accepted through any other means.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Assistant Professor/Senior Consultant post at IGIMS Patna?
faq.answer: The Assistant Professor/ Senior Consultant post carries a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 1,50,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IGIMS Patna Tele MANAS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 66 years for Assistant Professor/Senior Consultant and Senior Resident/Consultant, and 59 years for Clinical Psychologist/Psychiatric Social Worker/Psychiatric Nurse, Project Co-ordinator, and Data Entry Operator.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IGIMS Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is not mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IGIMS Patna Tele MANAS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection for Assistant Professor/Senior Consultant and Senior Resident/Consultant is through Screening and Interview. For Clinical Psychologist/Psychiatric Social Worker/Psychiatric Nurse, Project Co-ordinator, and Data Entry Operator, selection is through Screening, with a written test if necessary.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job at IGIMS Patna?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely contractual, for a period of six months, extendable depending on performance and at the discretion of the competent authority. Selected candidates will have no right or claim to a regular appointment at IGIMS, Patna.
